name: Castpipe's Task
summary: Master Mechanic Castpipe is calling capable travelers to Ironforge. He needs help recovering records from the ruined halls of Gnomeregan, where vital mechanical and technical knowledge remains trapped.

sections.title: A Call to Tinkertown
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell and was placed under radioactive quarantine, its surviving gnomes took refuge in Ironforge's Tinkertown. Troggs and irradiated constructs still overrun their great home. Deep in the city, computing arrays hold operational records and mechanical schematics. Master Mechanic Castpipe is enlisting outsiders willing to brave the toxic halls and recover files that may help explain what went wrong or aid a return to Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Assembly Endorsement
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle, of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, spreads word of Castpipe's effort. Castpipe does not belong to the academic body, but fellow gnomes respect his technical skill and support his work. Rustfizzle calculates an eighty-four percent chance that the operation has strategic value. Travelers can report to Tinkertown for orders.

faq.answer: Master Mechanic Castpipe is a respected gnomish engineer in Tinkertown, Ironforge. He organizes salvage teams and data recovery in the underground ruins of Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why does Castpipe want data from Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: When Gnomeregan was contaminated and evacuated, its mainframe memory was left holding critical technical knowledge, blueprints and internal system logs. The displaced gnomes need this information as they hope to rebuild.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome scholar with the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. He advocates for Castpipe's recovery effort and directs capable travelers to it.
Master Mechanic Castpipe can be found in Tinkertown, the gnome-settled district in the eastern quarter of Ironforge.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Castpipe?
faq.answer: Reporting to Master Mechanic Castpipe leads to Data Rescue, an operation inside the fallen city. Travelers must enter Gnomeregan's contaminated interior and recover computer punch cards and storage media.

faq.q: What is the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences?
faq.answer: The Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences is a respected gnomish society devoted to scientific, magical and mechanical study. Members such as Gaxim Rustfizzle use probability to assess important work.

angles.text: For you as a gnome, each recovery effort preserves a piece of your fallen home from radiation and destruction. Castpipe's work touches your people's survival.
For you as an engineer, Gnomeregan's data cores hold computational marvels and advanced schematics unmatched elsewhere on Azeroth.
For you in the Alliance, helping displaced gnomes secure their lost archives supports Tinkertown and strengthens the Alliance's technological standing.
